description:
Travis AFB is seeking 720A Kelvin Varley Voltage Divider. This item is replacement for an asset required on CA/CRL R14. The FLUKE 720A Kelvin Varley Voltage Divider was an initial special procurement in 2020 to be fielded to base level PMEL's to enable input voltages to be divided to within 0.1 part per million. Please see attached documents for more information. Please send responses to the emails below.

SSgt Edward Kim at edward.kim.7@us.af.mil and Mr. Vitaliy Kim at vitaliy.kim.1@us.af.mil 

This sources sought ends 9 April 2026 at 1:00 PM PDT.
